mentions.name: learningto.co
mentions.description: A free interactive learning site for data structures and algorithms, built from the author's experience passing Google interviews and positioned as a free alternative to LeetCode.
mentions.problem: Interview prep platforms like LeetCode are paid, leaving job candidates without free interactive DSA practice.
mentions.audience: People preparing for technical coding interviews
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a free interactive learning site on data structures and algorithms based on passing Google interviews. Think leetcode but free.

evidence.value: I built a free interactive learning site on data structures and algorithms based on passing Google interviews. Think leetcode but free.
